title: prefill vs decode: chunked speculative prefill + stage-overlap + kernel scheduler + KV-cache optimizations
author: Ava Chen
description: Summary: Implement chunked prefill pipeline, speculative prefill for short responses, and stage-overlap scheduling improvements alongside a lightweight kernel scheduler and KV-cache hot-paths. Motivation: Reduce end-to-end latency and improve GPU utilization on mixed-length workloads by overlapping prefill/ decode stages, avoiding long blocking prefill for short prompts, and selecting kernels dynamically to reduce stalls. Design: 1) Chunked prefill splits large prompt prefill into configurable chunks processed in the prefill stage to allow earlier decode overlap; 2) Speculative prefill performs a low-cost prefix prefill and triggers speculative decode for likely short completions, falling back to full prefill on mismatch; 3) Stage-overlap scheduler introduces a per-device work-queue and epoch-based prefetch so prefill and decode workers can overlap without KV cache corruption; 4) Kernel scheduler picks optimized kernels based on sequence-length heuristics at runtime and pins short-kernel executions to reduce JIT overhead; 5) KV-cache hot-path reduces locking and uses epoched versioning to enable safe concurrent reads during overlap. Backwards compatibility: runtime flags gate all changes (prefill.chunked=true, prefill.speculative=true, scheduler.stage_overlap=true). Testing: unit tests for KV epoching, integration perf harness results showing 8-18% p95 latency reduction on mixed workloads and 22% throughput improvement on short-response workloads; CI fuzz and stress tests added. Checklist: - [x] Design doc linked - [x] Unit/integration tests - [x] Perf benchmarks added - [x] Feature flags and dogfood rollout plan - [x] Docs/console metric hooks - [x] Security review

conversation: Samir Gupta: Could you detail the fallback path when speculative prefill mispredicts?

Ava Chen: Speculative prefill starts with a low-cost prefix prefill; if the decode produces an end-of-seq or low-entropy result within the speculative window we commit; on mismatch we abort speculative state, run the remaining chunks of full prefill and re-schedule decode. The transition is guarded by the feature flag to avoid state machine regressions.
